# Q-051 E7: a_usd_deposit_and_its_fee_on_a_holding_account.txt booked as
# 2,720.00 USD moved from Assets:USD Savings, whose dollars are the opening
# balance of usd_held_in_savings_as_an_opening_balance.txt, the bank's 0.72
# USD fee still in the same transaction, drawing on that opening balance's
# cost basis and valued at what it cost, 0.97.
#
# The fee gives the cost basis it spends, so it is what left, and the rest
# moved: 2,720.00 out of savings and into Wise draws down no cost basis and
# opens none. The deposit's own cost basis is not established, and the
# opening balance's falls by the fee alone, to 2,999.28, what the two
# accounts hold between them.
#
# Verified by
